card.name: Inside trial and drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through a name or code, such as a clinical trial name (SPARTAN, PALOMA-2, SafeHER, COU-AA-301) or a drug name (fluconazole, meloxicam), where the name continues or ends just after.

modes.label: Trial names
modes.description: The last piece of a clinical trial name or number, right before the trial is cited again or compared.

modes.label: Drug and other names
modes.description: Inside a drug or body-part name, just before the ending is complete.
